eps.o: Karen navigates life after her release. Wendy and Eddie adjust to a new normal. Old friends and lingering tensions resurface at a Washington Wizards game hosted by new-to-town WAG Courtney. Tia is presented with rumors about her personal life and is forced to face some hard truths.

Karen celebrates her return home with a party theme that no one can decode. Gizelle tries to restore her friendship with Tia. Stacey restores her romance with Thiemo. A former green-eyed ally peeps Gizelle’s messy antics.

Robyn pushes Ashley and Gizelle to do better as Tia discovers that Gizelle hasn’t been as sensitive as she would expect. Stacey and Thiemo take a big step, but luxury event planner Courtney is not considered for hiring. Alexis' birthday party goes awry when the ladies hijack the festivities.
